summary: Caution for pilots in the Scottish area about forecast low atmospheric pressure, especially around Glasgow, Edinburgh and Prestwick.
text:
CAUTION - LOW ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE IS FORECAST IN THE SCOTTISH
TMA. ALL PILOTS, ESPECIALLY THOSE INBD TO OR OUBD FM GLASGOW,
EDINBURGH, PRESTWICK, ABERDEEN, NEWCASTLE, BELFAST ALDERGROVE
AND BELFAST CITY ARE TO EXER CTN WHEN DES OR CMB THROUGH THE
TRL/ALT DUE TO THE SIG DIFFERENCE BTN THE AD QNH AND THE STD
PRESSURE SETTING.
